_doc: What a developer loses by moving to Clever Cloud, shown on the compatibility screen as visibly as the gains. Keys are provenance ids (rules/<id>.json) plus "*" for every repository; plan.py shows the entries of "*" and of the PRIMARY provenance only. Each entry: text (one short line, English), source (where the fact comes from), and optional when: "hds" = only when the plan targets HDS (health data yes or not sure), "database" = only when the plan lands a database (an optional one too), "postgresql" = only when it lands a PostgreSQL database (PITR: the Clever side, pgBackRest on request, is PostgreSQL's; never said for MySQL or MongoDB). Only losses Clever Cloud confirmed; no platform fact invented here. PITR is named only as a condition ("if your current plan includes it") for the origins whose managed databases may include it (Heroku, Scalingo): this file cannot know the plan.
